sentences.zh: 詔可其奏。

translations.literal: An edict approved his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his memorial.

sentences.zh: 士衎，官至崇慶軍節度使、知西外宗正事。

translations.literal: Shi Kan's offices reached Military Commissioner of the Chongqing Army and Director of Western Outer Imperial Clan Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Kan rose to Military Commissioner of the Chongqing Army and Director of Western Outer Imperial Clan Affairs.

sentences.zh: 右諫議何溥論士衎強市海舟，罷官。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrator He Pu impeached Shi Kan for forcibly purchasing sea-going vessels, and he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator He Pu impeached Shi Kan for forcibly purchasing sea-going vessels, and he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 已而詔歸南班，奉朝請。

translations.literal: Soon afterward an edict restored him to the Southern Branch, attending court as honorary.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward an edict restored him to the Southern Branch, where he attended court as an honorary official.

sentences.zh: 隆興中，以邊事未寧，與士籛奏減奉給恩賞之半以助軍興。

translations.literal: In the Longxing era, because border affairs were still unsettled, he and Shi Qian memorialized to reduce stipends and favor grants by half to assist the war effort.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longxing era, because border affairs were still unsettled, he and Shi Qian memorialized offering to cut their stipends and favor grants in half to assist the war effort.

sentences.zh: 詔加諭。

translations.literal: An edict added commendation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended them further.

sentences.zh: 仲儡，景王宗漢子也。

translations.literal: Zhonglei was the son of Prince of Jing Zonghan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglei was the son of Prince of Jing Zonghan.

sentences.zh: 初授右內率府副率，轉右監門衞大將軍。

translations.literal: Initially appointed Right Vice Commandant of the Inner Rate Office, then transferred to Right Grand General of the Gate Guards.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed Right Vice Commandant of the Inner Rate Office, then transferred to Right Grand General of the Gate Guards.

sentences.zh: 建炎末，授武功大夫、忠州防禦使。

translations.literal: At the end of Jianyan, appointed Military Merit Grandee and Defense Commissioner of Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jianyan era he was appointed Military Merit Grandee and Defense Commissioner of Zhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹興中，遷濟州，知南外宗正事。

translations.literal: In the Shaoxing era, transferred to Jizhou, Director of Southern Outer Imperial Clan Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing era he was transferred to Jizhou and appointed Director of Southern Outer Imperial Clan Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八年，加檢校少保、向德軍節度使，襲封嗣濮王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Honorary Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Xiangde Army added; inherited enfeoffment as Hereditary Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was given Honorary Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Xiangde Army and inherited the enfeoffment as Hereditary Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 仲儡生而不慧，以次得封。

translations.literal: Zhonglei from birth was not clever; he received the enfeoffment by order of seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglei had been dull-witted from birth; he received the enfeoffment only by order of seniority.

sentences.zh: 入見榻前慟哭，帝驚問故，答語狂謬，帝優容之。

translations.literal: On entering audience before the couch he wept bitterly; the Emperor startled asked the reason; his replies were wild and absurd; the Emperor treated him with forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: When he came before the imperial couch he wept bitterly; the startled Emperor asked why, and his answers were wild and incoherent; the Emperor treated him with forbearance.

sentences.zh: 九年，薨，上輟朝三日，追封瓊王，謚恭惠。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died; the court suspended audience for three days; retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Qiong, posthumous title Gong Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died; the court suspended audience for three days; he was retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Qiong and granted the posthumous title Gong Hui.

sentences.zh: 士輵，士俴弟也。

translations.literal: Shi Lie was the younger brother of Shi Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Lie was the younger brother of Shi Yan.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十八年，由建州觀察使襲封，授昭化軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Shaoxing, as Surveillance Commissioner of Jian Prefecture he inherited the enfeoffment and was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaohua Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Shaoxing he inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Surveillance Commissioner of Jian Prefecture and was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaohua Army.

sentences.zh: 初，懿王神貌奉安報恩寺西挾，屋居隘陋，士輵請別營祠堂，許之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Prince Anyi's portrait spirit image had been installed in the west wing of Bao'en Temple; the dwelling was cramped and shabby; Shi Lie requested a separate hall be built; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Prince Anyi's portrait spirit image had been installed in the west wing of Bao'en Temple, where the quarters were cramped and shabby; Shi Lie requested that a separate hall be built, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 久之，加檢校少保，累加開府儀同三司，賜嗣濮王居為世業。

translations.literal: After a long time, Honorary Junior Guardian was added; cumulatively Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies was added; the Hereditary Prince of Pu's residence was granted as hereditary property.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was given Honorary Junior Guardian and, cumulatively, Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies; the Hereditary Prince of Pu's residence was granted to his line as hereditary property.

sentences.zh: 除知大宗正事，累加三少，充醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Appointed Director of Imperial Clan Affairs; cumulatively the three Junior [titles] added; served as Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Director of Imperial Clan Affairs, cumulatively given the three Junior honors, and served as Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 淳熙七年薨，贈太傅，追封安王。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chunxi he died; posthumously made Grand Mentor, retroactively enfeoffed Prince of An.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chunxi he died; he was posthumously made Grand Mentor and retroactively enfeoffed Prince of An.

sentences.zh: 士歆，仲湜第十一子也。

translations.literal: Shi Xin was the eleventh son of Zhongchao.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Xin was the eleventh son of Zhongchao.

sentences.zh: 由保康軍節度使襲封，加開府儀同三司，累陞三少。

translations.literal: As Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army he inherited the enfeoffment; Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies added; cumulatively promoted through the three Junior [titles].
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army, was given Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies, and was cumulatively promoted through the three Junior honors.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年薨，贈太傅，追封韶王。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingyuan he died; posthumously made Grand Mentor, retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingyuan he died; he was posthumously made Grand Mentor and retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Shao.

sentences.zh: 不禾去

translations.literal: Bu Fu
translations.idiomatic: Bu Fu

sentences.zh: 不禾去，安懿王玄孫也。

translations.literal: Bu Fu was a great-great-grandson of Prince Anyi.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Fu was a great-great-grandson of Prince Anyi.

sentences.zh: 年七十六，累轉武功郎。

translations.literal: Aged seventy-six, promoted in succession to Military Merit Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: At seventy-six years of age, he had risen in succession to Military Merit Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 士歆既薨，不禾去年最高，得襲封，除褔州觀察使。

translations.literal: After Shi Xin died, Bu Fu was oldest in years and received the inherited enfeoffment; appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Shi Xin died, Bu Fu was the eldest by age and received the inherited enfeoffment; he was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 由庶官襲封自不禾去始。

translations.literal: Succession to the enfeoffment from a commoner office began with Bu Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Succession to the enfeoffment from a commoner rank began with Bu Fu.

sentences.zh: 慶元五年，轉武安軍承宣使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qingyuan, transferred to Commissioner of the Wu'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Qingyuan he was transferred to Commissioner of the Wu'an Army.

sentences.zh: 俄薨，贈開府儀同三司，追封蔣國公。

translations.literal: Soon he died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies, retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Jiang State.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies and retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Jiang State.

sentences.zh: 不璺，由武經大夫授利州觀察使，襲封。

translations.literal: Bu Wen, from Military Classic Grandee appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Lizhou, inherited the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Wen inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Military Classic Grandee and was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 開禧初，遷寧遠軍承宣使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaixi, transferred to Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaixi era he was transferred to Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 薨，贈開府儀同三司，追封安國公。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies, retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Anguo State.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies and retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Anguo State.

sentences.zh: 不儔，開禧二年，由安遠軍承宣使襲封，除昭慶軍節度使，遷檢校少保。

translations.literal: Bu Chou, in the second year of Kaixi, as Commissioner of the Anyuan Army inherited the enfeoffment, appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaoqing Army, promoted to Honorary Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Chou, in the second year of Kaixi, inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Commissioner of the Anyuan Army, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaoqing Army, and was promoted to Honorary Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十年薨，贈少師，追封高平郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Jiading he died; posthumously made Junior Preceptor, retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Gaoping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Jiading he died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and retroactively enfeoffed Prince of Gaoping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 不嫖，由武翼大夫襲封，授褔州觀察使，時嘉定十一年也。

translations.literal: Bu Piao, from Military Wing Grandee inherited the enfeoffment, appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou — it was the eleventh year of Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Piao inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Military Wing Grandee and was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou in the eleventh year of Jiading.

sentences.zh: 踰年而薨，贈開府儀同三司，追封惠國公。

translations.literal: After a year he died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies, retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Huiguo State.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies and retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Huiguo State.

sentences.zh: 臣僚上言：「嗣濮王元降指揮，雖有擇高年行尊之文，然高宗朝儀王仲湜以德望俱隆。

translations.literal: Officials memorialized: "The original edict on the Hereditary Prince of Pu, although it contains language about selecting by senior age and precedence, yet in Gaozong's reign Prince of Yi Zhongchao had both virtue and prestige eminent.
translations.idiomatic: Officials memorialized: "The original edict on the Hereditary Prince of Pu, although it contains language about selecting by senior age and precedence, yet in Emperor Gaozong's reign Prince of Yi Zhongchao was eminent in both virtue and prestige.

sentences.zh: 越仲孮而選拜；

translations.literal: Zhong Cong was passed over in selection and appointment;
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Cong was passed over in the selection and appointment;

sentences.zh: 武德郎鼘，次當襲封，以官卑，乃命士褭權奉祠事，越十六年始正士俴之封，是亦不拘定制也。

translations.literal: Military Virtue Gentleman Yan was next to inherit the enfeoffment, but because his rank was low, Shi Niao was appointed to preside over sacrificial affairs on an interim basis; only after sixteen years was Shi Yan's enfeoffment made formal — this too did not adhere to established regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The Military Virtue Gentleman Yan was next in line to inherit the enfeoffment, but because his rank was too low, Shi Niao was appointed to preside over sacrificial affairs on an interim basis; only after sixteen years was Shi Yan's enfeoffment made formal — this too departed from established regulation.

sentences.zh: 乞自今應封者，命大宗司銓量，都堂審察，閤門引見，然後奏取進止。」

translations.literal: We beg that from now on, for those due to receive the enfeoffment, the Imperial Clan Bureau be ordered to assess candidates, the Chief Council to examine them, the Gate attendants to introduce them in audience, and only then memorialize for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that henceforth, for those due to receive the enfeoffment, the Imperial Clan Bureau be ordered to assess the candidates, the Chief Council to review them, the Gate attendants to present them in audience, and only then memorialize for the Emperor's decision.

sentences.zh: 寧宗然之。

translations.literal: Emperor Ningzong approved this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong approved this.

sentences.zh: 士禾芻

translations.literal: Shi Hechu
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hechu

sentences.zh: 不淩，父士禾芻。

translations.literal: Bu Ling; father Shi Hechu.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Ling; his father was Shi Hechu.

sentences.zh: 不嫖既薨，不淩由右千牛衞將軍授褔州觀察使，襲封。

translations.literal: After Bu Piao died, Bu Ling from Right Thousand-Ox Guard General was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou and inherited the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: After Bu Piao died, Bu Ling inherited the enfeoffment from his post as Right Thousand-Ox Guard General and was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十五年，遷奉國軍承宣使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Jiading, transferred to Commissioner of the Fengguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Jiading he was transferred to Commissioner of the Fengguo Army.

sentences.zh: 十七年薨，贈開府儀同三司，追封惠國公。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies, retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Huiguo State.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with Honorary Three Excellencies and retroactively enfeoffed Duke of Huiguo State.
